ability.en: Regular practice can improve your ability to understand difficult texts.
ability.zh: 規律練習可以提升你理解困難文章的能力。

able.en: She was able to finish the assignment before dinner.
able.zh: 她能夠在晚餐前完成作業。

abroad.en: He hopes to study abroad after graduating from high school.
abroad.zh: 他希望高中畢業後到國外留學。

absence.en: Her absence from class was explained by a note from home.
absence.zh: 她缺席課堂的原因由家長的說明紙條交代。

absolute.en: There is no absolute answer to every question in life.
absolute.zh: 人生中的每個問題並不都有絕對答案。

absolutely.en: I absolutely agree that students need enough time to rest.
absolutely.zh: 我完全同意學生需要足夠的休息時間。

academic.en: Good time management can improve academic performance throughout the semester.
academic.zh: 良好的時間管理能提升整學期的學業表現。

accept.en: She decided to accept the invitation after checking her schedule.
accept.zh: 她確認行程後決定接受邀請。

access.en: Students can access the online materials with their school accounts.
access.zh: 學生可以使用學校帳號存取線上教材。

accident.en: The accident caused traffic delays near the station this morning.
accident.zh: 這起事故今天早上造成車站附近交通延誤。

account.en: You need an account to save your progress on the website.
account.zh: 你需要一個帳號才能在網站上儲存進度。

accurate.en: Accurate measurements are important when conducting a science experiment.
accurate.zh: 進行科學實驗時，精確的測量很重要。

achieve.en: Students can achieve better results by reviewing mistakes carefully.
achieve.zh: 學生仔細檢討錯誤後，可以取得更好的成果。

achievement.en: Finishing the project on time was a major achievement for the team.
achievement.zh: 準時完成專題對這個團隊來說是一項重大成就。

across.en: A new bridge was built across the river last year.
across.zh: 去年河上新建了一座橋。

act.en: We should act quickly when a serious problem is discovered.
act.zh: 發現嚴重問題時，我們應該迅速採取行動。

action.en: The school took action to reduce plastic waste on campus.
action.zh: 學校採取行動減少校園內的塑膠垃圾。

active.en: Staying active can help students maintain both energy and focus.
active.zh: 保持活動量能幫助學生維持體力與專注。

activity.en: This classroom activity requires students to work in small groups.
activity.zh: 這項課堂活動需要學生分小組合作。

actual.en: The actual cost was lower than the original estimate.
actual.zh: 實際成本比原先估計的低。

actually.en: The problem looked difficult, but it was actually quite simple.
actually.zh: 這個問題看起來很難，但其實相當簡單。

adapt.en: Students must adapt their study methods when the course becomes harder.
adapt.zh: 課程變難時，學生必須調整自己的讀書方法。

add.en: Please add your name to the list before leaving.
add.zh: 離開前請把你的名字加到名單上。

addition.en: The new library is a useful addition to the school campus.
addition.zh: 新圖書館是校園中很實用的新設施。

address.en: The speech will address several problems facing young people today.
address.zh: 這場演講將討論現今年輕人面臨的幾個問題。

admire.en: Many students admire her patience and willingness to help others.
admire.zh: 許多學生欣賞她的耐心與樂於助人的態度。

admit.en: He was willing to admit his mistake and correct it.
admit.zh: 他願意承認自己的錯誤並加以改正。

adult.en: Each adult in the group was responsible for two younger students.
adult.zh: 小組中的每位成年人都負責照顧兩名年幼學生。

advance.en: Technology continues to advance rapidly in many fields.
advance.zh: 科技在許多領域持續快速進步。

advantage.en: One advantage of online learning is greater flexibility in scheduling.
advantage.zh: 線上學習的一項優點是時間安排更有彈性。

adventure.en: The class trip became an unforgettable adventure for everyone involved.
adventure.zh: 這趟班級旅行成為大家難忘的冒險。

advertise.en: The club used posters to advertise its new weekend event.
advertise.zh: 社團用海報宣傳新的週末活動。

advice.en: Her teacher gave useful advice about preparing for the exam.
advice.zh: 老師給了她一些準備考試的實用建議。

advise.en: Teachers often advise students to review a little every day.
advise.zh: 老師常建議學生每天複習一點。

affect.en: Lack of sleep can affect both memory and concentration.
affect.zh: 睡眠不足會影響記憶力和專注力。

afford.en: The school found a cheaper option that everyone could afford.
afford.zh: 學校找到了一個大家都負擔得起的較便宜方案。

afraid.en: She was afraid of speaking at first but became more confident.
afraid.zh: 她一開始害怕上台說話，但後來變得更有自信。

age.en: People of every age can benefit from regular exercise.
age.zh: 各個年齡層的人都能從規律運動中受益。

agree.en: Most students agree that clear instructions make assignments easier.
agree.zh: 大多數學生都同意清楚的說明會讓作業更容易完成。

agreement.en: The two groups finally reached an agreement after a long discussion.
agreement.zh: 兩組人在長時間討論後終於達成共識。

ahead.en: Planning ahead can reduce stress before a busy week.
ahead.zh: 提前規劃可以減少忙碌一週前的壓力。

aid.en: The new software was designed to aid students with their research.
aid.zh: 這套新軟體是為了協助學生進行研究而設計的。

aim.en: Our main aim is to improve reading speed without losing accuracy.
aim.zh: 我們的主要目標是在不失準確度的情況下提升閱讀速度。

air.en: Fresh air entered the room when we opened the windows.
air.zh: 我們打開窗戶後，新鮮空氣進入房間。

airport.en: The bus leaves for the airport every thirty minutes.
airport.zh: 這班公車每三十分鐘開往機場一次。

alive.en: The small plant was still alive after several days without rain.
alive.zh: 這株小植物在好幾天沒下雨後仍然活著。

allow.en: The teacher will allow extra time for students who need it.
allow.zh: 老師會允許有需要的學生多一些時間。

almost.en: We almost missed the train because of heavy traffic.
almost.zh: 因為交通壅塞，我們差點錯過火車。

alone.en: She prefers to study alone when preparing for difficult tests.
alone.zh: 準備困難考試時，她比較喜歡獨自讀書。

along.en: We walked along the river after finishing lunch.
along.zh: 吃完午餐後，我們沿著河邊散步。

already.en: I had already finished the report before the meeting began.
already.zh: 會議開始前，我就已經完成報告了。

also.en: The course teaches grammar and also includes speaking practice.
also.zh: 這門課教授文法，也包含口說練習。

although.en: Although the task was difficult, the group finished it on time.
although.zh: 雖然任務很困難，小組仍準時完成。

always.en: She always checks her work carefully before turning it in.
always.zh: 她交作業前總是會仔細檢查。

amazing.en: The telescope gave us an amazing view of the night sky.
amazing.zh: 望遠鏡讓我們看到令人驚嘆的夜空景象。

amount.en: A small amount of daily practice can make a difference.
amount.zh: 每天少量練習也能帶來改變。

analysis.en: The report includes a detailed analysis of the survey results.
analysis.zh: 這份報告包含對問卷結果的詳細分析。

analyze.en: Students learned to analyze the graph before drawing conclusions.
analyze.zh: 學生學會先分析圖表再下結論。

ancient.en: The museum displays tools used by people in ancient times.
ancient.zh: 博物館展示古代人們使用的工具。

anger.en: He took a moment to calm his anger before replying.
anger.zh: 他先花一點時間平復怒氣再回應。

angle.en: The camera was placed at a different angle for the second photo.
angle.zh: 第二張照片把相機放在不同角度拍攝。

animal.en: Each animal in the habitat plays a role in the ecosystem.
animal.zh: 棲地中的每種動物都在生態系中扮演角色。

announce.en: The school will announce the contest results on Friday.
announce.zh: 學校會在星期五公布比賽結果。

annual.en: The annual sports day will be held next month.
annual.zh: 一年一度的運動會將在下個月舉行。

another.en: We need another example before the idea becomes completely clear.
another.zh: 我們還需要另一個例子，這個概念才會完全清楚。

answer.en: Please explain how you reached your answer to the question.
answer.zh: 請說明你是如何得到這題答案的。

anxiety.en: Good preparation can reduce anxiety before an important presentation.
anxiety.zh: 充分準備可以減少重要報告前的焦慮。

anxious.en: She felt anxious before the interview but prepared carefully.
anxious.zh: 她面試前感到焦慮，但仍仔細準備。

anyone.en: Anyone who finishes early may begin the next activity.
anyone.zh: 任何提早完成的人都可以開始下一個活動。

anything.en: Please ask if there is anything you do not understand.
anything.zh: 如果有任何不懂的地方，請提出來。

anyway.en: The weather was poor, but we enjoyed the trip anyway.
anyway.zh: 天氣雖然不好，但我們還是很享受這趟旅行。

apart.en: The two desks were placed several meters apart.
apart.zh: 兩張桌子相隔好幾公尺。

apartment.en: Their apartment is within walking distance of the station.
apartment.zh: 他們的公寓離車站走路就能到。

apologize.en: He decided to apologize after realizing that his comment was unfair.
apologize.zh: 他發現自己的評論不公平後，決定道歉。

appeal.en: The new design may appeal to students who prefer simple layouts.
appeal.zh: 這個新設計可能會吸引喜歡簡潔版面的學生。

appear.en: Several mistakes began to appear when the data was checked closely.
appear.zh: 仔細檢查資料時，開始出現幾個錯誤。

appearance.en: The building's appearance changed greatly after the renovation.
appearance.zh: 這棟建築整修後外觀改變很大。

apply.en: Students can apply for the program through the school website.
apply.zh: 學生可以透過學校網站申請這項計畫。

appreciate.en: I appreciate the time you spent helping with the project.
appreciate.zh: 我很感謝你花時間協助這項專題。

approach.en: We tried a different approach when the first method failed.
approach.zh: 第一種方法失敗後，我們改用不同的做法。

appropriate.en: Choose an appropriate example to support your main idea.
appropriate.zh: 請選擇合適的例子來支持你的主要觀點。

approve.en: The teacher must approve the topic before research begins.
approve.zh: 開始研究前，題目必須先得到老師核准。

area.en: This quiet area of the library is reserved for study.
area.zh: 圖書館這個安靜區域是保留給讀書使用的。

argue.en: Students should argue their position with evidence rather than emotion.
argue.zh: 學生應該用證據而非情緒來支持自己的立場。

argument.en: A strong argument needs both clear reasoning and reliable evidence.
argument.zh: 有力的論點需要清楚推理與可靠證據。

arise.en: Unexpected questions may arise during a class discussion.
arise.zh: 課堂討論中可能會出現意料之外的問題。

arrange.en: We arranged the chairs in a circle before the discussion.
arrange.zh: 討論前我們把椅子排成一圈。

arrangement.en: The seating arrangement made group discussion easier for everyone.
arrangement.zh: 座位安排讓大家更容易進行小組討論。

arrive.en: Please arrive ten minutes early for the school meeting.
arrive.zh: 請提早十分鐘到達學校會議。

article.en: The article presents several reasons for protecting local wildlife.
article.zh: 這篇文章提出幾個保護當地野生動物的理由。

artist.en: The artist used recycled materials to create the sculpture.
artist.zh: 這位藝術家使用回收材料創作雕塑。

ask.en: Do not be afraid to ask questions when something is unclear.
ask.zh: 有不清楚的地方時，不要害怕提問。

asleep.en: He was already asleep when the rain began.
asleep.zh: 開始下雨時，他已經睡著了。

aspect.en: The report examines every important aspect of the problem.
aspect.zh: 這份報告檢視了這個問題的每個重要面向。

assist.en: Several volunteers stayed after school to assist with the event.
assist.zh: 幾名志工放學後留下來協助活動。

assistant.en: The laboratory assistant prepared the equipment before class.
assistant.zh: 實驗室助理在上課前準備好器材。

assume.en: We should not assume the result before checking the evidence.
assume.zh: 在確認證據前，我們不應先假設結果。

attempt.en: Her first attempt was unsuccessful, but she learned from it.
attempt.zh: 她第一次嘗試沒有成功，但她從中學到經驗。

attend.en: More than two hundred students will attend the lecture.
attend.zh: 超過兩百名學生將參加這場講座。

attention.en: Please pay close attention to the safety instructions.

attitude.en: A positive attitude can make difficult tasks easier to manage.
attitude.zh: 正向的態度能讓困難任務更容易應付。

attract.en: The colorful poster helped attract more students to the event.
attract.zh: 色彩鮮明的海報幫助吸引更多學生參加活動。

attractive.en: The website uses an attractive layout that is easy to navigate.
attractive.zh: 這個網站使用美觀且容易操作的版面。

audience.en: The audience remained quiet while the speaker explained the results.
audience.zh: 講者說明結果時，觀眾保持安靜。

author.en: The author uses examples to make the main idea easier to understand.
author.zh: 作者用例子讓主要觀點更容易理解。

available.en: The study room is available after four o'clock today.
available.zh: 今天四點後可以使用這間自習室。

average.en: The average score increased after students changed their study method.
average.zh: 學生改變讀書方法後，平均分數提高了。

avoid.en: Check your work carefully to avoid simple mistakes.
avoid.zh: 仔細檢查作業可以避免簡單錯誤。

awake.en: She stayed awake long enough to finish the final chapter.
awake.zh: 她保持清醒直到讀完最後一章。

award.en: The science club received an award for its environmental project.
award.zh: 科學社因環保專題獲得一項獎項。

aware.en: Students should be aware of how much time they spend online.
aware.zh: 學生應該了解自己花多少時間上網。

away.en: The station is only a few minutes away from the school.
away.zh: 車站離學校只有幾分鐘路程。

background.en: Some background knowledge can make the article easier to understand.
background.zh: 具備一些背景知識能讓這篇文章更容易理解。

bad.en: A bad study habit can waste both time and energy.
bad.zh: 不良的讀書習慣會浪費時間和精力。

bag.en: She placed all her books in the bag before leaving.
bag.zh: 她離開前把所有書都放進袋子裡。

bank.en: The bank is located across the street from the post office.

basic.en: Students should understand the basic rules before starting the activity.
basic.zh: 學生開始活動前應先了解基本規則。

basis.en: The team meets on a weekly basis to review progress.
basis.zh: 團隊每週固定開會檢討進度。

beach.en: Volunteers collected plastic waste along the beach on Saturday.
beach.zh: 志工星期六沿著海灘撿拾塑膠垃圾。

beautiful.en: The mountain view was especially beautiful after the rain stopped.

because.en: We stayed indoors because the weather became unsafe outside.
because.zh: 因為戶外天氣變得不安全，我們待在室內。

become.en: Reading regularly can become a natural part of your routine.
become.zh: 規律閱讀可以成為日常生活中自然的一部分。

before.en: Please review the instructions before beginning the experiment.
before.zh: 開始實驗前請先閱讀說明。

begin.en: The meeting will begin as soon as everyone arrives.
begin.zh: 等大家都到齊後，會議就會開始。

beginning.en: The beginning of the story introduces the main characters clearly.
beginning.zh: 故事開頭清楚介紹了主要角色。

behavior.en: The study examines how sleep affects classroom behavior.
behavior.zh: 這項研究探討睡眠如何影響課堂行為。

behind.en: The bicycle parking area is behind the main building.
behind.zh: 腳踏車停放區在主建築後方。

believe.en: Many students believe that practice is more useful than memorizing rules.
believe.zh: 許多學生相信練習比死背規則更有用。

belong.en: These books belong on the top shelf of the cabinet.
belong.zh: 這些書應該放在櫃子的最上層架子。

below.en: Write your answer in the space below the question.
below.zh: 請把答案寫在題目下方的空格中。

benefit.en: One benefit of exercise is better concentration during study.
benefit.zh: 運動的一項好處是讀書時更能專心。

best.en: The best solution may depend on the specific situation.
best.zh: 最好的解決方法可能取決於具體情況。

better.en: Students often learn better when they receive clear feedback.
better.zh: 學生在得到清楚回饋時通常學得更好。

between.en: There is a clear difference between the two methods.
between.zh: 這兩種方法之間有明顯差異。

beyond.en: The discussion moved beyond the textbook and included real examples.
beyond.zh: 討論超越了課本內容，也加入真實例子。

big.en: A big project becomes easier when divided into smaller tasks.
big.zh: 大型專題拆成較小任務後會更容易完成。

bird.en: A small bird landed on the classroom window this morning.
bird.zh: 今天早上一隻小鳥停在教室窗邊。

birth.en: The museum record includes the artist's place and date of birth.
birth.zh: 博物館紀錄包含這位藝術家的出生地與出生日期。

blind.en: The design includes features that help blind users navigate the website.
blind.zh: 這個設計包含協助視障使用者操作網站的功能。

block.en: A fallen tree blocked the road for several hours.
block.zh: 一棵倒下的樹阻塞道路好幾個小時。

blood.en: The lesson explained how blood carries oxygen through the body.
blood.zh: 課程說明血液如何把氧氣運送到全身。

blue.en: The blue folder contains all the materials for today's lesson.
blue.zh: 藍色資料夾裡裝著今天課程的所有教材。

board.en: The teacher wrote the key points on the board.
board.zh: 老師把重點寫在黑板上。
